facts.en: Earned a Bachelor of Science in geography at Fictional Larchdelta University in 2018.
facts.zh: 2018 年在虚构落叶松三角洲大学获得地理学理学学士学位。

facts.en: Paid mapping assistant at Fictional Rainspan Survey Services from 2018-08 to 2021-11.
facts.zh: 2018-08 至 2021-11 在虚构雨跨测绘服务公司任有薪制图助理。

facts.en: There, traced features from approved survey drawings and recorded the drawing revision used for each edit.
facts.zh: 在该公司依据获批测绘图描绘要素，并记录每次编辑所用图纸版本。

facts.en: Paid geospatial data analyst at Fictional Brookgrid Utilities from 2021-12 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2021-12 至 2026-08 在虚构溪网公用事业公司任有薪地理空间数据分析员。

facts.en: Maintains point and line asset layers in QGIS using approved installation records.
facts.zh: 使用 QGIS，依据获批安装记录维护点状及线状资产图层。

facts.en: Checks coordinate reference system labels, duplicate asset IDs and disconnected line endpoints before proposing an update.
facts.zh: 提出更新前检查坐标参考系标签、重复资产编号及未连接的线端点。

facts.en: Writes SQL queries to compare asset IDs between a staging table and the current register.
facts.zh: 编写 SQL 查询，以比较暂存表与现行登记册中的资产编号。

facts.en: Records unresolved drawing conflicts in an issue log and sends them to the survey lead.
facts.zh: 在问题日志中记录尚未解决的图纸冲突，并提交测绘负责人。

facts.en: The survey lead approves spatial accuracy and the asset owner authorizes publication; the candidate prepares the proposed edits.
facts.zh: 测绘负责人批准空间精度，资产负责人授权发布；候选人准备拟议编辑。

facts.en: Co-led a register reconciliation pilot in 2025-02 with a database analyst.
facts.zh: 2025-02 与一名数据库分析员共同牵头登记册核对试点。

facts.en: Personally wrote the identifier-matching query and documented unresolved joins; the colleague built the import process.
facts.zh: 个人编写编号匹配查询并记录未解决的关联；导入流程由同事建立。

facts.en: The pilot compared 1240 register rows representing 1185 distinct assets because some assets had multiple record rows.
facts.zh: 该试点比较 1240 行登记记录，代表 1185 项不同资产，因为部分资产有多行记录。

facts.en: The pilot flagged 37 rows for review; no confirmed count of defective assets was reported.
facts.zh: 该试点标记 37 行供审核；未报告经确认的缺陷资产数量。

facts.en: Uses QGIS, SQL, spreadsheet pivot tables and a documented peer-review checklist.
facts.zh: 使用 QGIS、SQL、电子表格数据透视表及有文档记录的同行审核核对表。

facts.en: Completed an internal data-handling workshop in 2024-03 without receiving a professional surveyor qualification.
facts.zh: 2024-03 完成内部数据处理工作坊，未获得专业测绘师资格。

facts.en: Explains proposed record changes to field coordinators using annotated map extracts.
facts.zh: 通过带注释的地图摘图向现场协调员解释拟议记录变更。

facts.en: Volunteered with Fictional Reedpath Walking Group from 2019-05 to 2022-10, maintaining an outing calendar.
facts.zh: 2019-05 至 2022-10 在虚构芦径步行团做志愿者，维护出行日历。

facts.en: Made a personal map of imagined islands in 2023, using entirely invented coordinates.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人想象岛屿地图，使用完全虚构的坐标。

facts.en: Enjoys drawing contour-style patterns and binding sketchbooks.
facts.zh: 爱好绘制等高线风格图案及装订素描本。

facts.en: Mentored a new mapping assistant through supervised edit reviews but had no formal line-management appointment.
facts.zh: 通过受监督的编辑审核指导一名新制图助理，但未正式担任直属人员管理职务。
